conditions: Synthetic data only. No real athletes, no integration, no production. V1 authority NO. Not human review, not empirical validation, not medical clearance.

The runtime checks only the values hash (QRE-RFC-A-10): any change to any of these files needs a new independent SSCTR check to confirm or remove this record.

A plausibility envelope, never a probability, a coverage or a confidence interval (kind PLAUSIBILITY_ENVELOPE, probabilistic false, calibrated false). The handoff's synthetic sanity thresholds are recorded as NOT MET (inside the envelope 63.8% against >= 80%; per arm and no-response fast-side criteria also not met) and are never presented as met. No accuracy claim (SSCTR-RFC-A-06).

Before athlete-facing use: E3 (the Founder/PCG reading of the catalog rule, r1 C4) and E4 (Product copy and Data semantics). The copy owners are told that the slower end is not a floor: in the generator the truth was slower than it in up to about a quarter of cases (A-06). The Founder and Product are told that with one pre-plan result the forecast exists only in weeks 1-8 of a 16-week plan, because of the V1RC 56-day currency, and that race week then shows nothing (B-1, A-07). Currency, margins and wMax are not relaxed to keep it on screen.

Before integration: QRE-RWS-F-01 closed (disjoint fields by author with an adapter outcome test, else Founder decision), hard gate E-1 met, the two voices, custody with keyed integrity and atomic persistence of every record. The in-week withdrawal (no week is ever shown changed) holds only under that custody (SEC-RFC-B-02). The inherited V1RC conditions (R-11, integration without options: SEC-RFC-A-05) apply.

Before integration: measure how many weeks the in-week withdrawal removes (REPORTS_CHANGED_SINCE_THE_WEEK_STARTED, BREAK_DECLARED_SINCE_THE_WEEK_STARTED). If it is material, order the reports (two voices) or ask the Founder about the engine.

Before integration or a real athlete: QRE-RFC-B-02. On a restart the same day, with the new plan starting that day, a run of the old plan reported earlier that day is credited to the new plan's session of the same id. Compare instants, not days, and add a same-day restart test. SSCTR-RFC-B-02: if a future break can be announced, it must be recorded so that the withdrawal can read it.

Empirical recalibration of G, tau and wMax against real estimate-versus-race results before any accuracy claim (r1 F1, handoff D7), including SSCTR-RFC-B-01 (a reference measured after a zero-credit stretch sits lower on the curve); re-review on the first real data and by 2027-05-13 at the latest.

The forecast feeds nothing (no band, test, estimate, goal comparison, dose, progression, phase, eligibility or race-day mode); range first, central never alone; the marathon only as the current estimate; no goal relation in race week; no clinical inference.
Synthetic data only. No real athletes, no integration, no production. V1 authority NO.
Bound to the values and to the same four runtime files at 0d3015b as the V1X-RUN-FORECAST record; any change needs a new independent SSCTR check.

Observational only. Changes no capacity, estimate, forecast, band, dose or progression. The actions are explain, offer the V1RC field test when P3 offers one, suggest reporting a race, or 'effort governs': never a change. No copy invites running faster than the cue. The exceptional session is shown, never voted.

Each session is read against the band it was delivered with. Before integration (SEC-RFC-B-01): the record of formats is under keyed custody, because a resealed extra format row can flip an insight's state. Recommended to a successor: read the format the admitted execution cites (execution.formatHash) and nothing else.

Before integration: QRE-RWS-F-01 (a merged device report can hide a non-comparable fact, and the session then votes), hard gate E-1, the two voices, custody (SEC-RFC-B-02 applies to the in-week withdrawal of the insights too), and the measured frequency of in-week withdrawals.

SSCTR-RFC-A-05 re-opens on any change to the RWS formats or conversion, or if native reports start to carry a work pace. QRE-RFC-B-02 (same-day restart) applies to the delivered-band reader as well, before integration.

paceRevision.statement: NO record of V1X-PACE-REVISION exists in this file, and NO record of that boundary is valid over these bytes, whatever file or option carries it. The athlete-confirmed revision of the threshold band is implemented, off by default, NOT approved, and does NOT fail closed. It must not be turned on over these bytes. Turning it on needs new code that closes its conditions, a new independent review of that code, a new freeze, and an integration that meets IC-2. Open: SEC-RFC-A-01, A-02, A-03, A-10; SSCTR-RFC-A-03, A-11 and the question of A-09; QRE-RFC-A-04, B-03; the L-12 condition; hard gate E-1 and QRE-RWS-F-01 (SEC-RFC-A-06). 'Off by default' is not 'safe'. A freeze over these bytes must state this, and its verifier should fail if any record with boundaryId V1X-PACE-REVISION is present (SEC-RFC-B-03).
